entry.title: Model-72 1.0.1
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Model-72 1.0.0
entry.summary: # Model-72 1.0.0 A port of [CA-72](https://github.com/idlefoundry/ca-72) (Idle Foundry), the circuit-modelled 1970s monosynth, to Akai MPC OS standalone: a native plugin with a skin drawn for the MPC's screen. Unofficial; not affiliated with Idle Foundry or Moog Music. Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later; the source for this release is this tag. - **QUALITY LO**: CA-72's light voice, MONO / POLY (2-10) / UNISON, ENTROPY, stereo, DRIVE, AUTO GAIN. About 1.3-2.7 % of a Force core a voice. - **QUALITY
